data.one_liner: Encrypted synchronous key‑value storage for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a fast, in‑memory key‑value store that encrypts data on disk using AES‑CTR with SHA‑256 MAC. Supports basic types and offers listeners for changes across Android, iOS, Web, macOS, Linux and Windows.
use_when: You need secure, lightweight persistent storage without async APIs.
You want a drop‑in replacement for GetStorage with encryption.
Cross‑platform apps that require listeners on storage changes.
avoid_when: You need relational queries or large binary blobs.
You require native secure enclave APIs or biometric unlock.
Complex migrations or schema evolution are needed.
strengths: Synchronous API for simple use cases
Change listeners per box or key
weaknesses: All data kept in memory may affect large datasets
Limited to basic types (String, int, double, Map, List)
No advanced query or indexing features
data.setup_notes: Call GetSecureStorage.init with a password before use; no additional native permissions required.

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides platform‑specific secure storage (Keychain/Keystore) with native encryption.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple unencrypted key‑value storage when security is not required.
